title: Where a body comes from decides how safe it is

quiz.q: Which of these is a statutory body?
quiz.why: Right. The NHRC was set up under the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993.

review.note: Written and voiced by Claude (AI voices, Kokoro), 8 Nov 2026. Not yet checked by a subject or Hindi editor. Check every number and date against the listed sources.

lines.say: The CAG and the NHRC both watch the government.
But one is in the Constitution, and one is not.

beats.say: The CAG and the NHRC both watch the government. But one is in the Constitution, and one is not.

lines.say: Constitutional bodies are named in the Constitution itself.
The Election Commission, the U-P-S-C, the C-A-G and the Finance Commission.

beats.say: Constitutional bodies are named in the Constitution itself. The Election Commission, the U-P-S-C, the C-A-G and the Finance Commission.

lines.say: Statutory bodies come from ordinary laws, like the N-H-R-C, from 1993.
Regulators like SEBI, from 1992, are statutory too.

beats.say: Statutory bodies come from ordinary laws, like the N-H-R-C, from 1993. Regulators like SEBI, from 1992, are statutory too.

lines.say: A statutory body can be reshaped by a simple law.
A constitutional one needs an amendment. That's real protection.

data.text: A law can be changed by a simple majority. The Constitution can't.

beats.say: A statutory body can be reshaped by a simple law. A constitutional one needs an amendment. That's real protection.
